rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday adjective for feeling or showing anger.

example.english: They are so angry that they refuse to talk to me.
example.jyutping: keoi5 nau1 dou3 m4 hang2 tung4 ngo5 gong2 je5

rows.note: Use this for a wound or body part that is swollen and painful, rather than for emotional anger.

example.english: My foot is swollen and painful; I’m not angry.
example.traditional: 我隻腳腫痛，唔係我嬲呀。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zek3 goek3 zung2 tung3 m4 hai6 ngo5 nau1 aa3
